name: my-crm
description: Independent provider-neutral CRM expertise that consumes discovered BOS application contracts

interface.shortDescription: Use discovered CRM capabilities through BOS.
interface.longDescription: Use the installed BOS product to discover current organization-defined CRM sources, entities, fields, operations, limits, errors, and exact deterministic HTTPS actions. Preserve source records while applying provider-neutral CRM reasoning, freshness, recovery, and presentation.
defaultPrompt: Use My CRM's configured BOS default unless I explicitly selected another authorized organization. In this multi-tenant service, never inherit another plugin's default, construct authority selectors, or cross context boundaries. Search current CRM sources for external attendees from the last completed meeting. Preserve provenance, freshness, conflicts, coverage, and failures; summarize; make no changes. If the default is unavailable or none qualify, report and stop without asking for org data.
